description: Open the MCP App for human review of the saved study plan and complete current panel estimate. The first call only previews and does not spend. For App clients, a human must click Approve and launch in the App. For clients without MCP Apps, return the saved plan and quote in chat, ask the human to confirm, then call this tool again with the returned chat_approval_nonce and human_confirmed=true. Never infer confirmation from a prior study or quote. The estimate must match the study, country, inputs, balance and price at approval time.

country_code.description: Required explicit country code from userintuition://catalog/panel-countries. Never infer a country.

estimate_id.description: Current estimate identifier from estimate_panel. Paid launch fails if the study, inputs, balance, or price changed, or the estimate expired.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

incident_rate.description: Percentage points. Values below 10 require submit_feasibility_request instead of direct launch.

name: launch_panel
title: Review Panel Launch
